QUOTE: `constant_time_impl.h` defines `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set, the compiler is GNU-compatible (`__GNUC__`, and not old armcc5), and the target is one of: 32-bit ARM/Thumb (`MBEDTLS_CT_ARM_ASM`), AArch64, x86-64, or i386.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined in the header from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler and architecture predefined macros. That means it is derived, not set in mbedtls_config.h. The answer never says "derived" outright, but the mechanism is stated.
